data.one_liner: Write CSV data to a StringSink with RFC 4180 support
data.what_it_does: csvwriter provides a lightweight API to generate CSV files by writing rows to a StringSink. It handles header creation, data escaping, and line endings across platforms.
use_when: You need to generate CSV files in a Dart-only environment
You want a dependency-free solution for CSV output
You need cross‑platform support (Android, iOS, web, desktop)
avoid_when: You require advanced CSV features like streaming large files or custom delimiters
You need to read CSV files
You need integration with other data formats
weaknesses: No streaming API for very large files
